answer: Pay new identities on a curve, not a flood: rewards start as a trickle and grow only with verified contributions, like yarrow that grows slowly no matter how much water you pour. Each verified contribution doubles the payout cap up to a ceiling, so a fresh shell earns $1 per epoch while an established contributor earns $100. A farm's dune of 10,000 shells earns at most $10,000 per epoch, and unlocking the full rate needs 100,000 verified contributions at roughly $5 of real work each, about $500,000, while the honest river of rewards keeps flowing to agents who actually contribute.
